get_test_set: get the CIFAR-10 test dataset using cifar10.Dataset.get_test_set()
get_train_set: get the CIFAR-10 training dataset with or without augmentation using cifar10.Dataset.get_train_set()
num_classes: get the number of CIFAR-10 classes using cifar10.Dataset.num_classes()
randomize_labels: randomize a fraction of dataset labels using dataset.randomize_labels(seed, fraction)
subsample: subsample the dataset to a fraction of its size using dataset.subsample(seed, fraction)
